labeler: eval agent, from the chart text in test_dataset.py
method: Each chart was labeled from the note, labs, medications, and coded conditions. The rules pipeline was not used to decide a label. A code is expected only when the chart documents it. A code is a hard negative only when the chart contains a trap the coder should not add. Combination codes that the rules cannot emit, because a parent is not yet coded, stay in expected_gaps so the miss is visible.
vocabulary_note: Scored codes use the ICD-10 strings this repository already emits (E78.0, N18.3, I50.9, I50.22). Sharper billable codes that the rules never propose, such as N18.32 for stage 3b and D63.1 for anemia of CKD, are named in label_notes and are not false negatives.

patients.name: Maria Elena Rodriguez

expected_gaps.rationale: E11.9 is coded. The assessment says uncontrolled type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia and HbA1c is 8.4%.
Assessment says chronic kidney disease stage 3 and eGFR is 48.
Assessment says hypercholesterolemia and LDL is 198.
Assessment says anemia and hemoglobin is 11.2. D63.1 would be more specific for anemia of CKD and is outside this vocabulary, so it is not scored.
Assessment says developing peripheral neuropathy. E11.42 would be the diabetic-neuropathy code and is outside this vocabulary, so it is not scored.
Assessment says likely diabetic nephropathy. CKD is not yet coded, so the rules' combination step will not propose E11.22. It is still a true gap.
Hypertension is assessed and CKD stage 3 is assessed. N18 is not coded, so the rules will not propose I12.9. It is still a true combination gap.

must_not_flag.rationale: Stage 3 is documented, so unspecified CKD is the wrong code.
The assessment says hypercholesterolemia, not unspecified hyperlipidemia. Triglycerides of 220 do not rename that assessment.

patients.label_notes: E11.9 and I10 are supported. E11.9 is underspecified, not unsupported.

patients.name: James Thompson

Assessment says COPD, stable on tiotropium and albuterol.

patients.label_notes: Only I10 is coded. HbA1c 5.4 does not support diabetes. I50.22 replaces I50.9 because the note documents reduced ejection fraction.

expected_gaps.rationale: Assessment says major depressive disorder, stable on sertraline, PHQ-9 8. That is treatment of a diagnosed disorder, not a screening-only mention.
Assessment says hypothyroidism, TSH 8.2, levothyroxine increased.

patients.name: Robert Williams

expected_gaps.rationale: E11.9 is coded and the assessment says poorly controlled diabetes with HbA1c 9.1%.
E11.9 and N18.3 are both coded and the assessment says diabetic nephropathy.

I10 and N18.3 are both coded. The guideline combination still applies when hypertension and CKD are both present, even though this note emphasizes diabetic nephropathy and does not restate hypertension.
Assessment says HFrEF, EF 30%, BNP 720, furosemide and carvedilol. This chart is still scored as I50.9. The I50.22 relabel was approved only for pt-002.
Assessment says anemia of chronic disease and hemoglobin is 10.5.
Assessment says hypercholesterolemia and total cholesterol is 265.
Assessment says peripheral neuropathy in both feet.

must_not_flag.rationale: The assessment names hypercholesterolemia. Unspecified hyperlipidemia is the wrong target.

patients.label_notes: N18.3, E11.9, and I10 are already coded. N18.3 covers the stage-3 family in this vocabulary; N18.32 is the sharper stage-3b code and is not scored.

patients.name: Patricia Davis

must_not_flag.rationale: HbA1c is 5.2 and the note says there is no evidence of diabetes. Do not upgrade E11.9.
The note says no signs of heart failure.
The note says no signs of COPD.
The note says the patient denies depression and the PHQ-9 is 2.
The note says the patient denies anxiety.
Hypothyroidism is a rule-out. TSH has not been resulted.
The note says no history of kidney disease and eGFR is 92.
Same kidney-disease denial.

unsupported_existing.rationale: E11.9 is on the condition list, but the note says no evidence of diabetes, the patient denies symptoms, and HbA1c is 5.2. Family history in the mother and sister is not the patient's diagnosis.
I10 is coded. This chart has no hypertension mention, no blood pressure, and no antihypertensive.
E78.5 is coded. This chart has no lipid mention, no lipid lab, and no statin.

patients.label_notes: The rules already drop the negated mentions. The unsupported codes are the two-way findings.

patients.name: Michael Johnson

expected_gaps.rationale: Active metformin and no diabetes code. There is no note. This is a review item, not an auto-add, but the coder should see it.
Active rosuvastatin and no lipid code.
Active amlodipine and no hypertension code.

must_not_flag.rationale: Amlodipine is on the CKD medication list in the rules and is not evidence of CKD.
Omeprazole alone does not establish GERD.
Sertraline alone does not establish major depression.

patients.label_notes: No notes and no labs, by design.
